name: Wizard Studied Transmogrifist
body:
Studied transmogrifists were among the first to master the craft, using it as a defensive option where spells like mage armor potentially failed. They have since pioneered the practice and use it to summon unique armors based on monsters with which they interact.

Research Transmogrification (Su)

Rather than schools of magic, studied transmogrifists focus on monster types, using transmogrify armor to gain the benefits of those monsters when they cast summon monster.

At 1st level, a studied transmogrifist chooses a monster type.

For this purpose, he can choose the full outsider category, rather than an individual subtype. The studied transmogrifist gains summon monster each time he would learn a school spell, and he can use that spell to summon monsters of the chosen type that meet the CR requirements of the spell. For a sample list of monsters by CR and type, see the table above.

In addition, at 1st, 4th, and 8th level, the studied transmogrifist can gain and use one natural attack, spell-like ability, or activated supernatural ability possessed by the creature his summon monster spell would otherwise summon. If the abliity learned in this way duplicates a spell, that spell cannot be one the studied transmogrifist couldn’t prepare (due to being a higher level, or on another spell list).
